title: DEMO: Autonomous trading agents trigger flash volatility
summary: DEMONSTRATION RECORD. A fictional exchange's post-incident note says interacting autonomous trading agents amplified a 90-second price swing. AEGIS assesses this as an emerging AI-systems risk rather than a malicious event.
impact_assessment: Observed: short-lived price disruption; no settlement failures. Potential: larger disruptions as agent adoption grows.
priority_rationale: Moderate: emerging systemic risk with limited immediate harm.
monitoring_actions: Follow regulator commentary on autonomous trading controls
